rationale: The agent looked up the user by name and ZIP and retrieved order details, which suggests authentication and scoping to the user’s orders. However, the agent executed a write action (return_delivered_order_items) without any visible explicit user confirmation, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. Additionally, the user asked how much they could get back; the conversation shown does not provide any refund amount or final, correct financial details. The closing message thanks the user but gives no refund figure or confirmation summary. Given these issues, the request was not completed in line with policy.
